question: Saurabh purchased a ring at 26% less of the marked price and sold it at 10% more than the marked price. Find the approximate profit earned by him.
solution:
**Given:**

Saurabh purchased a ring at 26% less of the marked price and sold it at 10% more than the marked price.

**Formula used:**

Profit% = dfrac{Selling Price - Cost Price}{Cost Price} times 100
